entries.scope_evidence: Actual dry spinning into finished fibres; own conclusion explicitly discusses textile requirements and theater drapes, stage curtains and fire-fighting suits. Classified as fibres, not finished cloth or yarn. Four separate LMF, LMF/SiO2, LMF/PVA and LMF/SiO2/PVA feeds dry-spun through 0.12mm×100 spinneret and heated acid-gas channel, then solidified230–250°C1h into four finished fibres. Finished fibres twisted into LOI plaits are assay preparation, not woven cloth or an additional manufactured state. Exact four finished-fibre codes occur in own Table1TG/Table2LOI and p8 prose; whole manufacture includes all four codes. Own initial fibre TG and plait LOI; no donor assay or separate casting.

entries.scope_evidence: Direct three-layer glass-mat structure and automotive application are documented, but no fibre-forming eligible polymer is established for the thermoset UPR. Existing rule admits eligible fibre-forming-polymer composites; it does not currently provide a separate glass-mat/thermoset-panel category. Scope held pending explicit user scope boundary/rule. Panel is not relabeled nonwoven or fibre. Six own initial RTM/postcured whole composite panels with three OwensCorning glass mats≈20wt% and UceflexUC5530-M orthophthalic unsaturated polyester/styrene resin; unfilledP-GF and fiveNa/Na(MPS)/30B/30B(MPS)/CaCO3 variants. Generic whole-panel cure/postcure and own labels bridge Tables2/3; exact TG cut/shape and TGconditioning remain unreported. Six existing broad GradeA panel states each have two existing N2/air10°C/min conditions from own Table2T10/sourceT60/R600 and own Table3LOI±0.5. Two gases are one manufactured sample state. NeatPTable3LOI is not a new pair because no own Table2TG; pure clay TG not panel data.
